sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B Explained: Hybrid Attention, 262K Context, New Benchmarks
sources.snippet: What is Qwen3.8-27B? Qwen3.8-27B is a dense 27 billion parameter model released under the Apache 2.0 license, built around a hybrid attention design that mixes linear attention with full attention across its 64 layers.
